meta.comment: feat.farmtypes (FEAT-104) / engine.farming (MOD-045, §31/§17/§25) — the farm-type catalogue. This file is the sole source for every per-type figure (footprint, soil-quality band, terrain/slope preference, BDI term, stocking density, chain handoff) the typed catalogue in internal/engine/farming resolves — GR#15: no per-type figure lives as a Go numeric literal in internal/engine/farming/*.go. Each 'types' entry is a DISTINCT modelled facility with its own parameter set (the load-bearing rule); regime (conventional vs organic) is deliberately orthogonal to type and belongs to engine.farming's AC-8 regime bundle, not this file (ASM-679).
meta.taxonomy: Five §31 facility categories (ASM-677): arable (wheat/barley/rapeseed/potatoes), livestock (dairy/beef/sheep/pigs/poultry), orchard (apples/cherries/soft fruit), market garden (field veg/poly-tunnel salads/hops), vineyard/winery (vines). A named §31 crop/livestock is a VARIANT within its category, not its own top-level type.
meta.balanceRegime: Every per-type figure in this file is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass. No figure is a final balance number; each 'types' entry carries a non-empty 'disclosure' field naming it as such (ASM-676). Tests assert shape/direction/distinctness, never a specific magnitude.

units.footprintCells: cells — the farm's physical footprint in world cells
units.soilBand: the per-type soil-quality requirement band (a closed enum: chalkDownland/pasture/chalkSlope/fertileLoam)
units.terrain: the per-type terrain/slope preference (a closed enum: openDownland/grazingDownland/chalkSlope/shelteredValley — vines/orchard prefer chalk slopes, §31)
units.bdiTerm: the per-type additive contribution into engine.farming's five-factor regional Biodiversity Index (dimensionless; direction is authoritative, magnitude is a placeholder)
units.headPerCell: livestock stocking density, head per cell (livestock type only, per-variant — §31 'with stocking density')
units.chain.destination: the downstream chain destination enum (mill/dairy/abattoir/packhouse/winery — §31 chains)
units.yieldNote: chain-output tonnage is declared by the commodity+destination handoff, not a t/day figure here — the t/day producer coefficient is engine.farming's AC-11 surface; this catalogue only types the handoff

arable.disclosure: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — footprintCells, soilBand, terrain, bdiTerm and chain handoff are directional placeholders, not final balance figures
